caption:
The skin track on a clear morning above Kamifurano. Two guides, two small groups, and nobody in a hurry.

Most days we ride the lifts and duck into the trees. But on a morning like this, when the storm has passed and the sky opens, we put the skins on and walk. Forty minutes up buys you a run nobody else has touched.

Touring is always optional. If you'd rather stay on the lift side, one of us stays with you. Send us a message if you want to hear how a week is split between the two.
